Entries.Text: The Material Reloader works with Elden Ring only.
Connects to the running game: lists the materials loaded models use, and reloads the selected material in the game from this editor's copy. The game must run offline with EAC disabled.
Couldn't open the game process (error {0}). EAC may be running, or Smithbox may need the same rights as the game.
Couldn't find the game's material functions (matches: {0}, {1}). This game version may not be supported.
Connected, but the game hasn't loaded its materials yet.
Connected, but the game's material table looks wrong ({0} buckets). This game version may not be supported.
Reads the game's materials every {0} seconds while this tool is shown.
Close the connection to the game and turn off automatic refresh.
Replace the selected material in the running game with this editor's copy, including unsaved changes.
Select a MATBIN material to reload it.
Send the selected material to the game. Models loaded after this use the new version.
Models already loaded keep the old material until they load again. Reload the world (below) to rebuild every model with the new material.
Send the game's original version of this material, undoing edits in the game without changing the project.
The vanilla materials are still loading; try again in a moment.
{0} isn't a vanilla material, so there's no original to send.
Send every material with unsaved changes at once, followed by one world reload (the choice above).
Send every material with unsaved changes to the game, then do the choice above once. Materials with check errors are left out.
Send to the game on save
When you save the Material Editor while connected, the materials the save writes are also sent to the game, followed by the choice above. Automatic saves don't send.
A reload is still running, so {0} material(s) weren't sent to the game. Send them again when it's done (History or Reload Modified).
Reloaded {0} of {1} materials in the game.
The materials sent to the game this session, newest first. Send sends the editor's current copy again; Vanilla sends the original.
Last sent from: {0}. Result: {1}. Click to select it.
Send the editor's current copy of this material again.
Empty the history. Nothing in the game changes.
Then: quit to the title screen
What happens after the material reloads. Reloading the world saves and loads your save again, so every model is rebuilt with the new material.
Reload the world from your save, or quit to the title screen. Loading the world again rebuilds every model, so all of them use the materials reloaded here.
Save, then load the same save again without going to the title screen.
Couldn't reload the world: the game's load request wasn't found in this version.
Couldn't reload the world: no save is loaded.
Couldn't reload the world: a load is already pending.
The game didn't save within 10 seconds, so the world wasn't reloaded. Is a world loaded?
The game didn't start the load within 10 seconds, so the request was withdrawn.
Quit to the title screen now. Then choose Continue to load back in.
{0}  Quitting to the title screen. Choose Continue to load back in.
The game didn't act on the quit request within 5 seconds, so it was withdrawn. Is a world loaded?
Couldn't quit out: the game's menu isn't set up yet.
Couldn't quit out: the game's quit request wasn't found in this version.
The game has no material named {0}. Only materials in the game's binders can be reloaded; a new material needs a restart.
Couldn't allocate memory in the game.
Couldn't start the reload in the game (error {0}).
The reload didn't finish within 10 seconds.
{0} has errors (see Material Check), so it wasn't sent to the game.
The models loaded in the game and the materials they use. Click a model to show its materials, and a material to select it here. Users is how many model materials hold it in the game.
{0} models loaded; {1} of {2} materials in use.
Connect to the game to see its models and materials.
Show only models whose ID or name contains this text, or that use a material whose name contains it.
Show only one kind of model, or materials used by that kind.

Sort by when each model or material loaded, newest first: walk up to something and it comes to the top. Ones loaded within {0} seconds are marked in the Loaded column; ones already loaded when Smithbox connected go last.
The game's loaded model list wasn't found in this version; use the Materials tab.
Run the Used By scan to see each model's materials.
None of this model's materials are in use, or the Used By scan doesn't include it.
Not in use in the game right now.
In use by {0} model material(s), in: {1}
This project's material binders don't have this material.
